gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: No explicit aggregate prior-year development (PYD) figure for 2023 is provided in the report. The claims development triangle and movements are materially affected by RITC and LPT transactions (assumed business), which distort simple triangle-based PYD calculations. The opening gross claims outstanding and LOB-level closing balances are explicit and used here; PYD is therefore reported as null per instructions. LOB movements were computed as the year-on-year change in gross outstanding by statutory class and mapped where possible to standard Lloyd's LOB names; one statutory class ('Credit and suretyship') was mapped to a closest standard category with low confidence.
